text: Nora wanted to read a storybook inside, but the door was locked. The key was missing. Dad said, “I could help you.” Nora said, “I would like to locate the key.” She fetched the lantern from the porch. With the lantern, she found the key under the bench. She unlocked the door with the key, and she stepped inside the cottage. She hung the key on the hook. She opened the storybook beside Dad.
